design: Map shores ([coast]): a tile with at least 5% land whose east, south or west edge (its outer three terrain pixels) is at least 75% sea or shallows; of those, the most open edge, ties in the order south, east, west. The rules step one tile that way from the shore and put a new ship there (src/sim/prison.c). 32 east, 37 south, 30 west.
